name: motif_overview
description:
Read the project Overview. Displays the latest saved counts, Text Coverage, manual-analysis agreement, timing, and warnings. It reads stored evidence and does not start a new run.
Command: overview. Agent class: Read.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_capture_baseline
description:
Capture a Baseline. Reads the saved .fwdata project to create or reuse a file-backed Baseline. Use it when the latest FieldWorks save should be the point of comparison for later work.
Command: baseline capture. Agent class: Evaluate.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_grammar
description: Read grammar. Reads the Baseline grammar by kind and exact object identity. Choose a kind to page through its objects, or omit it for counts.

kind.description: What to list. Omit for counts of every kind.

query.description: Only objects whose name or abbreviation contains this text.

offset.description: Items to skip, for the next page.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_lexicon
description: Read lexicon. Searches Baseline entries, senses, forms and glosses. Detailed results include allomorphs and their environments.

query.description: Text the headword, a gloss or a form contains.

morph_type.description: Only entries of this morph type, such as 'stem' or 'suffix'.

offset.description: Entries to skip, for the next page.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_word
description:
Read one word's context. Reads a word's captured FieldWorks presence and every stored analysis with its individual Opinion. Uses the current Baseline without requiring a Selection or an Assessment, and reports whether FieldWorks has saved since.
Command: word-context. Agent class: Read.
Word: The exact word form to read.
ExpectedBaseline: The required Baseline identity; null accepts the current Baseline.

word.description: The word, exactly as written in the project.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_start_proposal
description:
Start a Proposal. Starts a named Draft holding one related set of semantic changes. Measure it and revise it before Finalize. Only a person can Apply.
Command: new. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
Label: The short description a person reads while reviewing the Proposal.

label.description: A one-line description a reviewer reads in Motif's window.

comment.description: Why this change is right: the evidence, in a few sentences.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_guide
description: Read encoding guidance. Reads an encoding guide or the draft, Dry Run, Trial, revise and Finalize workflow.

name: motif_add_lexeme_form
description:
Author a lexeme form. Stages a lexeme form with explicitly authored spelling, writing system and morph type in a Draft. Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize; only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-lexeme-form. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

morph_type.description: Id of the morph type of the new form.

ws.description: Writing system tag the form is written in.

environments.description: Optional environment ids restricting the new form.

is_abstract.description: True for a root-and-pattern form with no fixed segments.

sense.description: Id of an existing sense of the entry to gloss. Needs gloss_ws and gloss_text.

gloss_ws.description: Writing system tag of the gloss.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_set_gloss
description:
Set a sense gloss. Stages the explicitly authored gloss of one sense in one writing system in a Draft. Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize; only a person can Apply.
Command: add-set-gloss. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
Target: The exact canonical identity of the existing object.
Ws: The project writing system tag for this value.
Text: The authored Unicode text.
DependsOn: Explicit operation dependencies; array position implies no dependency.

ws.description: Writing system tag of the gloss.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_remove_operations
description:
Remove Draft operations. Removes explicit operations from a Draft while respecting declared dependencies. Revise and measure the content again before Finalize. Only a person can Apply.
Command: remove-operations. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
OperationIds: The exact operation identities to remove from the Draft.
Force: Whether to override the requested command constraint.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_dry_run
description:
Dry Run a Proposal. Queues a Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal on a throwaway copy of its Baseline. Its effects are bound to that content and project state.
Command: dry-run. Agent class: Evaluate.
ProposalId: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
Read a Dry Run. Waits for the Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal and reads its effects. Content and Baseline identify whether the evidence remains current.
Command: dry-run --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
ProposalId: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
JobId: The exact job identity returned when evidence was queued.
Timeout: The maximum wait for a result before returning progress.

job.description: A job id from an earlier 'running' result, to keep waiting for it.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 40.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_trial
description:
Trial a Proposal. Measures a Draft or finalized Proposal on a throwaway copy, producing a Dry Run and Assessments. Read negatives now parsing, positives lost, unfinished cases, other changes and counts before revising.
Command: trial. Agent class: Evaluate.
ProposalId: The exact canonical Proposal identity.
Scope: The named Assessment scope, or the project default when omitted.
Words: The explicit words to measure, or the configured Selection when omitted.
AllWords: Whether to measure all project wordforms.
ExpectedDraftRevision: The required Draft revision for this Trial.
Limits: Optional per-word limits copied from the earlier Assessment being compared.
BaselineAssessmentIds: The project Assessments used as the before side of a Trial Difference.
NegativeWords: Attested counterexamples that should not parse.
Read Trial progress. Waits for a Trial job and reads its state. Read the stored Difference after the Trial completes.
Command: trial --wait. Agent class: Evaluate.
JobId: The exact job identity returned when evidence was queued.
Timeout: The maximum wait for a result before returning progress.

words.description: Words to parse. Omit to use the saved Default Selection.

negative_words.description: Attested counterexamples that should not parse.

job.description: A job id from an earlier 'running' result, to keep waiting for it.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result. Default 40.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_try_word
description:
Trace a word. Runs PanGloss for one word against the project's current Baseline and returns its diagnostic. Use it to inspect recorded analyses and trace events.
Command: trace. Agent class: Evaluate.
Word: The exact word form to trace.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_finalize_proposal
description:
Finalize a Proposal. Finalizes a Draft as an immutable Proposal revision for a person to review. Evidence for unchanged content on the same Baseline remains current.
Command: finalize. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
ExpectedRevision: The required Draft revision for this write.

expected_revision.description: The revision you last read, to refuse if the draft changed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_proposals
description:
List Proposals. Lists saved Proposals and Drafts, including each identity, label and status. Read one Proposal to inspect its semantic intent.
Command: list. Agent class: Read.

Show a Proposal. Reads one saved Proposal or Draft by id, with its status, label, comment and operations. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
Command: show. Agent class: Read.
ProposalId: The exact canonical Proposal identity.

proposal.description: A proposal id to show in full. Omit to list.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_activity
description: Read agent activity. Reads calls, Proposals and jobs from this conversation and the selected project.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_list_projects
description: List Known projects. Lists the Known projects a person has added to this installation. Select one by name or its recorded path for project tools.

name: motif_assess
description:
Measure a Selection. Runs PanGloss over chosen Texts or word forms and stores the resulting Assessments. After FieldWorks saves project changes, capture a new Baseline before measuring them.
Command: assess. Agent class: Evaluate.
Selection: The words or Texts to measure; null uses the saved Default Selection.
PerWordLimitMs: The per-word duration limit in milliseconds; null keeps the configured limit.
PerWordStepLimit: The per-word parser step cap; null keeps the configured cap.
ReplaceAssessmentId: The prior complete Assessment to replace for an explicit reparse.

words.description: Words to assess; omit for the Default Selection.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: The most list items to return in concise mode. Default 25.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_difference
description: Read Trial Difference. Pages through a stored Trial Difference by category. Unfinished parser cases are separate from words that no longer parse.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
